mentions.name: Scribe
mentions.description: A tool that reduces AI agent token usage in real-world tasks; comprehensive benchmarks are currently being run, with early results showing roughly 80% token reduction and a writeup planned.
mentions.problem: AI agents consume excessive tokens in real-world tasks.
mentions.source_excerpt: Now working on comprehensive benchmarks for another tool I built, https://github.com/sibyllinesoft/scribe. Results thus far showing it reducing agent token usage by ~80% in real world tasks, but I need to repeat to get variance. Hopefully I can get a writeup out soon.
